questions.label: B3(1)
questions.question_text: Explain one advantage of storing this data in three linked tables rather than in one table.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: Data is stored once / not repeated (less redundancy), e.g. a member's phone number is stored once, not with every enrolment.

questions.label: B3(2)
questions.question_text: Explain one advantage of storing this data in three linked tables rather than in one table.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: So it is changed in only one place / fewer inconsistencies / less storage space.

questions.label: B4(a)(2)
questions.question_text: Referential integrity is enforced in this database. Explain why referential integrity is enforced between the CLASSES table and the ENROLMENTS table.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: This stops records that are not linked (orphan records) / reduces data entry errors.

questions.label: B7(b)
questions.question_text: Name the validation check that makes sure the PHONE field cannot be left blank.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: Presence check (accept Required = Yes).

questions.label: B7(c)(1)
questions.question_text: The number of TERMS must be between 1 and 3. Name the validation check that should be used and write a suitable validation rule.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: Range check.

questions.label: B7(c)(2)
questions.question_text: The number of TERMS must be between 1 and 3. Name the validation check that should be used and write a suitable validation rule.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: >=1 And <=3 (accept Between 1 And 3).
Check / do not accept: Only one limit: no mark.

questions.label: B7(d)
questions.question_text: State one suitable validation check for the DATE OF BIRTH field.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Type check (must be a valid date) / range check (e.g. <Date()) / format check (dd/mm/yyyy).
Check / do not accept: Presence check alone: no mark.

questions.label: B8(a)
questions.question_text: State why a query may need a logical operator such as AND or OR.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: To search using more than one criterion / to combine conditions.

questions.label: B8(b)(1)
questions.question_text: Explain one reason why Like "*Beginner*" would be used in a search on the CLASS NAME field.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: The * wildcard stands for any characters / finds partial matches.

questions.label: B8(b)(2)
questions.question_text: Explain one reason why Like "*Beginner*" would be used in a search on the CLASS NAME field.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: It finds every class whose name contains Beginner (e.g. Adult Beginners) without typing the full name.
